migration_policy: Vesper hero, card, and face assets remain runtime migration sources only. Renaming, recoloring, or recropping them does not create final STARLINE character art.

quality_gate.minimum_bar: Production-grade subculture tactical RPG character art with crisp faces, coherent signature weapons, readable silhouettes, controlled detail hierarchy, and STARLINE observatory design language.
must_have: face and eyes remain readable in a 128px crop
signature weapon is physically held and defines the silhouette
character-specific color block is stronger than generic elemental color
dark observatory palette with restrained amber warmth and teal cold light
approved hero is the only source for card and face crops
reject_if: Vesper character renamed or merely recolored
glossy plastic 3D render or uniform AI airbrush finish
weapon floats, clips, changes shape, or cannot function
constellation glyph or zodiac label substitutes for identity

workflow: generate 3 to 4 hero candidates for one character
approve one hero or keep asset_blocked
derive card and face from the approved hero
approve PixelLab base and six animation states
validate alpha bounds and foot baseline before runtime
